review.reviewer: Implementation owner, design self-review with independent review finding
review.decision: Exercise the bilingual startup runbook examples through the existing phone board parser
review.notes: The independent review reproduced a heading the consumers cannot lift and documented the numbered reply contract. The examples in the shipped runbooks are the inputs, so a corrected hand-written test fixture cannot conceal a wrong runbook. Keep the mobile and macOS readers unchanged. The data is synthetic and the low-write local run uses the phone parser with Node assertions. The mobile Jest suite and installed-client acceptance remain CI and review activities.

cases.description: Both startup runbooks teach the recognized legacy decision section and reply format
cases.setup: Load one Markdown example from each bundled startup runbook. Include stable nonconsecutive item numbers, two bold groups, a recommendation and an item with a continuation.
cases.action: Parse each example with parseBoardSections, findAsk, askItems and askQuote. Remove the answered item, then separately provide an empty decision section.
cases.expected: Exact language-specific titles are lifted. The original number, short first-line quote and group are retained. An explicit recommendation is recognized. Removal leaves the other item and its number intact. An empty decision section produces no actionable item.
